programmes.name_en: Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme (SZHP)
programmes.amount_note: Interest-free housing loans repayable over 25 years; non-reimbursable grants for the poorest groups. Amount depends on case.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a house aid request via the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure portal

eligibility.income_note: MOEI's official Housing Assistance Request page states the applicant's monthly income should be no more than AED 100,000 — AED 1,200,000/year as an outer ceiling. Within that ceiling a housing calculator scores social, financial and residential circumstances, so grants go to much lower-income applicants.

programmes.source_snippet: Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme (SZHP), established in 1999, provides interest-free loans repayable over a 25-year period to citizens with low incomes.

programmes.name_local: برنامج إسكان مواطني أبوظبي - هيئة أبوظبي للإسكان
programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Housing Authority (ADHA) Housing Benefits
programmes.amount_note: Housing loans, land grants, ready-built homes and loan repayment exemptions for Abu Dhabi citizens; value depends on entitlement.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for housing services via Tamm or the Iskan Abu Dhabi centre

programmes.source_snippet: Abu Dhabi Housing Authority (ADHA) was created to provide suitable housing for Abu Dhabi citizens, manage housing loans' programme and coordinate all housing-related projects.

programmes.name_en: Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment (MBRHE) Dubai
programmes.amount_note: Residential plots, government houses, ready houses, maintenance/extension grants and housing loans for Dubai nationals; amount per policy.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for housing grants or loans via the MBRHE smart housing portal

programmes.source_snippet: Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment (MBRHE) was established in 2007. It aims at providing appropriate housing to the nationals of the emirate of Dubai.

programmes.name_en: Iskan Abu Dhabi One-Stop Housing Services
programmes.funder: Abu Dhabi Housing Authority / Iskan Abu Dhabi
programmes.amount_note: One-stop service for ADHA beneficiaries: housing grants, housing loans and purchase of residential land.
programmes.source_snippet: Iskan Abu Dhabi is a one-stop service centre for citizens eligible for housing benefits in the emirate of Abu Dhabi.

programmes.name_en: Sharjah Housing Assistance (Directorate of Housing)
programmes.funder: Government of Sharjah - Directorate of Housing
programmes.amount_note: Housing grants and loans for Emirati citizens of Sharjah; emirate-level counterpart to federal housing aid.
programmes.source_snippet: Sharjah's Directorate of Housing administers emirate-level housing assistance for Emirati citizens, alongside the federal Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme.

programmes.name_en: Sheikh Saud Housing Programme (Ras Al Khaimah)
programmes.amount_note: Emirate-level housing support (grants, loans, houses) for Emirati citizens of Ras Al Khaimah.
programmes.source_snippet: The Sheikh Saud Housing Programme provides housing support to nationals of Ras Al Khaimah, complementing federal housing assistance.

programmes.name_en: Emirati Family Growth Programme (ADHA Housing Loan Reduction)
programmes.amount_note: Reductions in outstanding ADHA housing loans for citizens who grow their families, per ADHA policy.
programmes.source_snippet: ADHA housing benefit packages include housing loan reductions for citizens under the Emirati Family Growth programme.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Emirati Salary Support Scheme
programmes.amount_note: Monthly salary top-up for Emiratis in private-sector roles, tiered by qualification (historically up to AED 7,000-8,000/month for up to 5 years); bands revised from September 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Nafis platform as a jobseeker or employee

eligibility.income_note: Top-up applies to private-sector salaries below the public-sector benchmark

programmes.source_snippet: Salary support: monthly top-up to the Emirati employee's salary for a defined period (commonly five years).

programmes.name_en: Nafis Child Allowance Scheme
programmes.amount_note: AED 800 per child per month for eligible Emirati private-sector employees; 2026 reform removed the previous cap on number of children.

eligibility.income_note: For Emiratis earning below AED 50,000 per month in the private sector

programmes.source_snippet: Emiratis earning below AED 50,000 per month and working in the private sector can now receive AED 800 per child monthly, with no upper limit on children.

programmes.name_local: برنامج نافس - دعم الباحثين عن عمل
programmes.name_en: Nafis Unemployment Support for Emiratis
programmes.amount_note: Time-limited benefit for Emiratis who lose private-sector jobs involuntarily: AED 7,000/month for the unemployed person (AED 4,500 unemployed spouse, up to AED 3,000 per child), subject to active job search.
programmes.source_snippet: An unemployed Emirati receives AED 7,000 per month; their unemployed spouse receives AED 4,500; eligible children receive up to AED 3,000.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Pension Contribution Support
programmes.amount_note: Government subsidy of GPSSA pension contributions for Emirati private-sector employees, closing the public-private pension gap.
programmes.source_snippet: GPSSA pension contribution: federal contribution to the General Pension and Social Security Authority scheme, equivalent to the employer contribution.

programmes.name_en: Nafis Training and Apprenticeship Support
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised accredited training and apprenticeship salary support for Emiratis entering private-sector roles.
programmes.source_snippet: On-the-job training support and apprenticeship support for young Emiratis and recent graduates.

programmes.name_local: معاش التقاعد - الهيئة العامة للمعاشات والتأمينات الاجتماعية
programmes.name_en: GPSSA Retirement Pension for Emiratis
programmes.funder: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly pension based on average contribution salary and years of service (2.67% per year of service under the 2023 law); GPSSA guarantees a minimum monthly pension of AED 10,000.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: An Emirati national is entitled to a pension if he/she as an insured person reaches retirement age of 60 years and completes an insured service period of 15 years.

programmes.name_en: GPSSA Disability and Survivor Benefits
programmes.funder: General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA)
programmes.amount_note: Pension and compensation for insured Emiratis in case of work-related disability or death, paid to the insured or eligible family members.
programmes.source_snippet: GPSSA manages disability pensions and survivor benefits distributed to eligible family members of a deceased insured member or pensioner.

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Pension Fund (ADPF) Retirement Benefits
programmes.amount_note: Pension for Emiratis employed in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi; contributions 26% of pensionable salary (11% employee, 15% employer) for new members.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: ADPF covers UAE nationals working in Abu Dhabi under a separate emirate-level pension system equivalent to the federal GPSSA scheme.

programmes.name_en: MoCE Social Welfare Programme (Monthly Social Assistance)
programmes.amount_note: Structured monthly allowances for low-income Emirati families; amount calculated under Federal Decree-Law No. 23 of 2024 based on family composition and income.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via the Ministry of Community Empowerment portal using UAE Pass

eligibility.income_note: No published number. The Ministry of Community Empowerment's own social welfare page (2026) says only that the total monthly family income must be below the eligibility threshold, without stating any AED figure; eligibility is determined case by case from the applicant's social and economic situation.

programmes.source_snippet: The Social Welfare Programme is a federal initiative implemented by Ministry of Community Empowerment (MoCE). It provides an integrated social safety net to Emirati families.

programmes.name_en: MoCE Inflation (Supplementary) Allowance
programmes.amount_note: Supplementary allowance for low-income Emirati households covering fuel price increases, food subsidies and a share of water/electricity costs.

eligibility.income_note: The UAE Government's official portal states the inflation allowance is for Emirati families whose total monthly income is less than AED 25,000 — AED 300,000/year. The allowance covers fuel, food and electricity/water cost increases and is paid on top of the basic social welfare allowance.

programmes.source_snippet: The UAE's social welfare framework offers a Supplementary Allowance including housing and inflation-related (fuel, food) components administered by the Ministry of Community Empowerment.

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Social Support Programme (ADSSA)
programmes.amount_note: Financial assistance for Abu Dhabi citizens whose monthly income is below the approved support line.

eligibility.income_note: Income below the Abu Dhabi-approved social support line

programmes.source_snippet: Apply for financial assistance if your monthly income is less than the approved support line in Abu Dhabi - The Abu Dhabi Social Support Programme.

programmes.name_local: المساعدات الاجتماعية - هيئة تنمية المجتمع دبي
programmes.name_en: Dubai CDA Periodic Social Assistance
programmes.amount_note: Periodic financial assistance for Dubai nationals on low incomes, administered by the Community Development Authority.

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested per CDA eligibility rules for Dubai citizens

programmes.source_snippet: Apply for periodic social assistance - for nationals from Dubai - Community Development Authority.

programmes.name_local: المساعدات الاجتماعية - دائرة الخدمات الاجتماعية الشارقة
programmes.name_en: Sharjah Social Services Department Financial Assistance
programmes.funder: Social Services Department, Government of Sharjah
programmes.amount_note: Financial assistance for Sharjah citizens whose income is at or below the approved assistance line.

eligibility.income_note: Income equal to or less than the approved assistance threshold

programmes.source_snippet: Apply for financial assistance if your income is equal to or less than the assistance provided by the Ministry of Community Development (for nationals of Sharjah only) - Social Services Department in Sharjah.

programmes.name_en: Marriage Fund Grant (AED 70,000)
programmes.amount_note: One-time AED 70,000 grant for first-time marriages where both spouses are UAE nationals; groom's net monthly income must not exceed AED 25,000.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the MoCE marriage grant portal within six months of the marriage contract
Attend the mandatory awareness course within 12 months of applying

documents_required.note: Net income must not exceed AED 25,000/month

eligibility.income_note: Groom's net monthly income must not exceed AED 25,000 after pension and housing deductions

programmes.source_snippet: Under Cabinet Resolution No. (5) of 2017, eligible Emirati couples can receive a one-time marriage grant of Dh70,000.

programmes.name_en: Medeem Marriage Support (Abu Dhabi)
programmes.funder: Department of Community Development - Abu Dhabi (Medeem)
programmes.amount_note: Marriage grants and family-development support services for young Emirati couples in Abu Dhabi under the Medeem model; amount per entitlement.
programmes.source_snippet: The Medeem model supports new Emirati families in Abu Dhabi with marriage support and family development services.

programmes.name_en: Thiqa Health Insurance Programme for UAE Nationals (Abu Dhabi)
programmes.funder: Department of Health Abu Dhabi / Daman
programmes.amount_note: Fully government-funded comprehensive health coverage for UAE nationals in Abu Dhabi, administered by Daman at SEHA and network facilities.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Thiqa is a fully government-funded insurance programme for UAE nationals only, administered by Daman since 2008. Emiratis access Thiqa free.

programmes.name_en: MOHAP Health Card (Subsidised Care for Citizens)
programmes.amount_note: Health card giving UAE nationals free or heavily subsidised treatment at MOHAP public hospitals and clinics, mainly in the northern emirates.
programmes.source_snippet: UAE nationals receive free or heavily subsidised care at MOHAP public facilities with a health card.

programmes.name_en: Free Public School and Federal University Education for Emiratis
programmes.funder: Ministry of Education / federal universities (UAEU, ZU, HCT)
programmes.amount_note: Free public schooling and tuition-free undergraduate study at federal universities (UAE University, Zayed University, Higher Colleges of Technology) for UAE citizens.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Education in government schools and federal higher education institutions is free for UAE nationals.

programmes.name_local: البعثات الدراسية الخارجية - وزارة التعليم العالي
programmes.name_en: MoHESR Scholarships for UAE Nationals (Study Abroad)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR)
programmes.amount_note: Scholarships for undergraduate and graduate study at ministry-recognised universities abroad, covering tuition and allowances; requires very good academic standing.
programmes.source_snippet: Ministry Of Higher Education & Scientific Research (MoHESR) provides scholarships to UAE nationals for graduate and undergraduate programmes to study abroad in one of the recognised universities.

programmes.name_local: منح مكتب المنح الدراسية - ديوان الرئاسة
programmes.name_en: Scholarship Office (Presidential Court) - DSS and SASP
programmes.amount_note: Distinguished Student Scholarship and Study Abroad Scholarship Programme for outstanding Emirati students at prestigious international universities.
programmes.source_snippet: Scholarship Office at Ministry of Presidential Affairs selects outstanding Emirati students to travel abroad to pursue education at prestigious international universities.

programmes.name_local: برنامج بعثة - صندوق تطوير قطاع الاتصالات
programmes.name_en: TDRA Betha ICT Scholarship Programme
programmes.funder: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (ICT Fund)
programmes.amount_note: Bachelor and master scholarships in ICT-related subjects for Emirati students in the UAE and abroad.
programmes.source_snippet: Through its ICT Fund, Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority offers Betha programme for undergraduate and graduate students wishing to study ICT-related subjects.

programmes.name_en: Ministry of Finance Masar College Scholarships
programmes.amount_note: College scholarships for UAE high-school graduates in finance, accounting and related disciplines at accredited UAE universities.
programmes.source_snippet: Under the Masar programme, Ministry of Finance (MoF) offers college scholarships to assist UAE high-school graduates in completing their studies in finance, accounting and other disciplines.

programmes.name_en: ADEK Scholarships (Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge)
programmes.amount_note: Scholarships for distinguished UAE students in Abu Dhabi in priority disciplines such as science, technology, teaching and urban planning.
programmes.source_snippet: Department of Education and Knowledge provides scholarships to distinguished UAE students by partnering with organisations throughout the UAE.

programmes.name_local: برنامج حمدان بن محمد للمنح الدراسية
programmes.name_en: Hamdan bin Mohammed Scholarship Program (Dubai)
programmes.amount_note: Scholarship programme for outstanding Dubai-based Emirati students to study at top universities.
programmes.source_snippet: Hamdan bin Mohammed Scholarship Program - Dubai Government.

programmes.name_en: Al Qasimi Foundation Scholarships (Ras Al Khaimah)
programmes.funder: Sheikh Saud bin Saqr Al Qasimi Foundation
programmes.amount_note: Undergraduate and postgraduate scholarships for UAE citizens from Ras Al Khaimah (and children of Emirati mothers resident there), domestic and overseas.
programmes.source_snippet: Candidates must be UAE citizens from Ras Al Khaimah (or children of a UAE national mother residing there), demonstrating exceptional academic records.

programmes.name_en: National and Reserve Service Benefits for Emiratis
programmes.funder: Ministry of Defence - National Service and Reserve Authority
programmes.amount_note: Employment protection, salary continuation and pension contribution coverage for Emiratis performing national service.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Employees called for national service keep their employment rights, with service periods counting toward pension and benefits.

programmes.name_en: Support for Emirati Fishermen (MOCCAE)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)
programmes.amount_note: Registration, equipment support and periodic assistance for licensed Emirati fishermen to sustain the traditional fishing sector.
programmes.source_snippet: MOCCAE supports licensed Emirati fishermen through registration services, equipment support and assistance programmes.

programmes.name_local: برامج دعم المزارعين - هيئة أبوظبي للزراعة والسلامة الغذائية
programmes.name_en: ADAFSA Agricultural Support Programmes (Abu Dhabi)
programmes.funder: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised agricultural inputs, veterinary services, extension advice and farm support for farm owners in Abu Dhabi.
programmes.source_snippet: ADAFSA provides subsidised inputs, veterinary care and technical extension services to farms in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

programmes.name_en: Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (Abu Dhabi)
programmes.amount_note: Interest-free loans of roughly AED 100,000-5,000,000 for Emirati-owned SMEs; direct funding requires 100% Emirati ownership and an owner aged 21-60.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit a business plan and financing application on the Khalifa Fund portal

programmes.source_snippet: Khalifa Fund: AED 100,000-5,000,000 loans at 0% interest for UAE nationals.

programmes.name_local: مؤسسة محمد بن راشد لتنمية المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة
programmes.name_en: Dubai SME (Mohammed Bin Rashid Establishment for SME Development)
programmes.funder: Dubai SME, Department of Economy and Tourism
programmes.amount_note: Business development services, mentorship, incubation, procurement access and funding pathways for Dubai-registered SMEs; some funding tracks are for Emirati founders.
programmes.source_snippet: Dubai SME, formally the Mohammed Bin Rashid Establishment for SME Development under Dubai's Department of Economy and Tourism, runs the Dubai Startup Hub for mentorship, incubation, and networking.

programmes.name_en: Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center (Sheraa)
programmes.amount_note: Incubation, acceleration, seed-funding access and mentorship for early-stage startups; open to UAE residents of all nationalities.
programmes.source_snippet: Sheraa (Sharjah Entrepreneurship Centre): Incubation, seed funding, and networking for early-stage entrepreneurs. Open to UAE residents of all nationalities.

programmes.name_local: تمويل الشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة - مصرف الإمارات للتنمية
programmes.name_en: Emirates Development Bank (EDB) SME Financing
programmes.amount_note: Direct and bank-partnered financing for UAE-registered SMEs in priority sectors (manufacturing, food security, healthcare, renewables, advanced technology).
programmes.source_snippet: Emirates Development Bank provides SME financing solutions for UAE-registered businesses in priority economic sectors.

programmes.name_en: Mohammed Bin Rashid Innovation Fund (MBRIF)
programmes.amount_note: Innovation Accelerator (mentorship, market access) and Guarantee Scheme (loan guarantees) for innovative companies registered in the UAE; open to all nationalities.
programmes.source_snippet: MBRIF supports innovative entrepreneurs from around the world who wish to establish economic activities in the UAE, offering financing solutions and an accelerator programme.

programmes.name_en: Dubai Future Accelerators (Dubai Future Foundation)
programmes.amount_note: Cohort-based accelerator pairing startups with Dubai government entities; pilots and contracts without equity taken. Open to international founders.
programmes.source_snippet: Dubai Future Accelerators connects startups with Government of Dubai entities to pilot solutions, with no equity taken.

programmes.name_en: Small Business Relief (UAE Corporate Tax)
programmes.amount_note: Eligible resident taxable persons with revenue up to AED 3,000,000 per period can elect to be treated as having no taxable income (0% corporate tax) for periods ending on or before 31 December 2026.

eligibility.income_note: Revenue must not exceed AED 3,000,000 in the relevant and previous tax periods

programmes.source_snippet: Small Business Relief allows eligible businesses with revenue at or below AED 3 million to elect no taxable income for corporate tax purposes.

programmes.name_en: Free Zone 0% Corporate Tax on Qualifying Income
programmes.amount_note: Qualifying Free Zone Persons pay 0% corporate tax on qualifying income (standard 9% rate applies to non-qualifying taxable income above AED 375,000).

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: A Qualifying Free Zone Person is subject to 0% corporate tax on qualifying income under the UAE corporate tax regime.

programmes.name_local: عدم فرض ضريبة على الدخل الشخصي
programmes.name_en: No Personal Income Tax on Employment Income
programmes.amount_note: The UAE levies no personal income tax on salaries, wages or personal investment income of residents and citizens.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: The UAE does not levy personal income tax on individuals' employment or personal income.

programmes.name_en: UAE Golden Visa (Long-Term Residence)
programmes.funder: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)
programmes.amount_note: 5- or 10-year renewable self-sponsored residence for investors, entrepreneurs, exceptional talents, outstanding students and frontline heroes; includes family sponsorship and no sponsor requirement.

documents_required.doc: Category evidence (investment, degree, salary or nomination)

eligibility.income_note: Category-dependent; e.g. property investment of AED 2 million or skilled salary thresholds

programmes.source_snippet: The Golden visa is a long-term residence visa which enables foreign talents to live, work or study in the UAE while enjoying exclusive benefits.

programmes.name_en: Green Residence for Freelancers and Self-Employment
programmes.funder: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)
programmes.amount_note: 5-year self-sponsored residence for freelancers/self-employed with a MOHRE freelance permit, a bachelor's degree and annual self-employment income of at least AED 360,000 (or proof of financial solvency).

eligibility.income_note: Evidence of annual income from self-employment of AED 360,000, or proof of financial solvency

programmes.source_snippet: The Green residence for freelancing/self-employment is a 5-year visa that does not require a sponsor or employer.

programmes.name_en: Retire in Dubai (5-Year Retirement Visa)
programmes.funder: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism / GDRFA Dubai
programmes.amount_note: 5-year renewable residence for retirees aged 55+ meeting financial criteria (savings, Dubai property, or monthly income thresholds).

eligibility.income_note: Financial criteria: savings, property value or monthly income thresholds

programmes.source_snippet: The Retire in Dubai programme offers a 5-year renewable residency visa to retirees aged 55 and over who meet financial criteria.

programmes.name_en: Involuntary Loss of Employment (ILOE) Unemployment Insurance
programmes.amount_note: Pays 60% of average basic salary for up to 3 months per claim; capped at AED 10,000/month (Category A, salary up to AED 16,000, premium AED 5/month) or AED 20,000/month (Category B, premium AED 10/month). Requires 12 consecutive months of subscription; claim within 30 days of job loss.

procedure_steps.detail: Subscribe and pay premiums via iloe.ae, the ILOE app, kiosks or exchange houses
File a claim within 30 days of involuntary termination via the ILOE portal or call centre 600599555

documents_required.doc: Bank IBAN and 6 months of salary statements

programmes.source_snippet: The scheme pays eligible workers up to three months of compensation (60% of basic salary, capped).

programmes.name_en: End-of-Service Gratuity (Article 51, UAE Labour Law)
programmes.amount_note: Statutory gratuity for foreign (non-GPSSA) employees completing 1+ year: 21 days' basic salary per year for the first 5 years, 30 days per year thereafter; capped at two years' total wage; payable within 14 days of contract end.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: 21 days' basic salary for each year of service for the first five years; 30 days' basic salary for each subsequent year of service.

programmes.name_en: Statutory Maternity Leave (60 Days)
programmes.amount_note: 60 calendar days for female private-sector employees: 45 days at full pay plus 15 days at half pay, from day one of employment; extensions for pregnancy-related illness or a sick/disabled newborn.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Female employees in the private sector are entitled to 60 calendar days of maternity leave - 45 days at full pay and 15 days at half pay.

programmes.name_en: Statutory Parental (Paternity) Leave (5 Working Days)
programmes.amount_note: 5 working days of fully paid parental leave for either parent, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth (Article 32 of Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021).

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Both parents are entitled to 5 working days of paid parental leave within 6 months of the child's birth.

programmes.name_en: Statutory Sick Leave (Up to 90 Days per Year)
programmes.amount_note: After probation and 3 months of service: up to 90 days of sick leave per year - first 15 days full pay, next 30 days half pay, remaining 45 days unpaid.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Employees are entitled to up to 90 days of sick leave per year: 15 days with full pay, 30 days with half pay and 45 days without pay.

programmes.name_en: Statutory Annual Leave (30 Calendar Days)
programmes.amount_note: 30 calendar days of fully paid annual leave per year of service (2 days per month for 6-12 months of service), under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Employees are entitled to annual leave of 30 calendar days for each year of service.

programmes.name_en: Wage Protection System (WPS)
programmes.funder: MOHRE / Central Bank of the UAE
programmes.amount_note: Mandatory electronic salary transfer monitoring that protects private-sector employees' wages; MOHRE can sanction employers who pay late or underpay.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: The Wage Protection System ensures employees' wages are paid in full and on time through monitored electronic transfers.

programmes.name_local: دعم الدعاوى العمالية - وزارة الموارد البشرية
programmes.name_en: MOHRE Labour Claims and Dispute Resolution
programmes.funder: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
programmes.amount_note: Free filing and mediation of labour complaints (unpaid wages, gratuity, arbitrary dismissal) via MOHRE, with referral to labour courts; claims up to AED 50,000 decided by MOHRE.

procedure_steps.detail: File a complaint via the MOHRE app, website or call centre 80060

programmes.source_snippet: Workers can file labour complaints free of charge with MOHRE for mediation and, where needed, referral to the labour courts.

programmes.name_en: Domestic Workers Law Protections
programmes.funder: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
programmes.amount_note: Statutory protections for domestic workers: weekly rest, 30 days paid annual leave, sick leave, end-of-service gratuity and regulated recruitment via Tadbeer centres.
programmes.source_snippet: Federal law on domestic workers guarantees rest days, annual leave, sick leave and end-of-service benefits for household workers.

programmes.name_local: التأمين الصحي الإلزامي دبي - باقة المنافع الأساسية
programmes.name_en: Dubai Mandatory Health Insurance / Essential Benefits Plan (EBP)
programmes.funder: Dubai Health Authority (DHA) / employers and insurers
programmes.amount_note: Employers must provide health insurance to employees in Dubai; the Essential Benefits Plan is the DHA-regulated minimum plan (roughly AED 500-800/year) for lower-salaried workers.

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

programmes.source_snippet: Health insurance is mandatory in Dubai: employers must cover employees, and the Essential Benefits Plan sets the minimum cover for lower-income workers.

programmes.name_en: Abu Dhabi Mandatory Health Insurance (Daman Basic/Enhanced)
programmes.funder: Department of Health Abu Dhabi / employers and Daman
programmes.amount_note: Employers and sponsors must provide health insurance in Abu Dhabi; Daman's Basic plan covers lower-income workers at a regulated premium.
